description: ReX: an input expander that picks out a stretch of the buffer inside the module it is attached to, by where it starts and how long it is; it goes to the left of that module

params.text: Sets the channel the stretch starts at, 1 to 16
Sets how many channels the stretch covers, 1 to 16; past the sixteenth channel it wraps round to the first

inputs.text: Replaces the start knob while it is patched; it does not attenuate the knob
Replaces the length knob while it is patched; it does not attenuate the knob

notes: this module is placed to the left of the module it expands, or beside another connected input expander on that side
a length longer than the buffer wraps round the buffer and repeats its values

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the start knob.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the length knob.
